01Presenters

Presenters.

Tomás Corrêa
CTO & Co-Founder

A biologist by training from the University of São Paulo, he was co-founder and CTO of Open Co (originally Geru), Brazil's first 100% digital lender, founded in 2014. Leading the company's technology for nearly nine years, he helped build one of the country's largest digital credit platforms, with over USD 1 billion in loans originated. In 2023 he co-founded Robbin, a B2B credit fintech for retail, where he remains CTO — a company that raised USD 8M in seed and recently announced a USD 108M round.

ex—now—
Marcos
Head of Data

A Computer Scientist from USP (IME-USP), with over a decade in data and technology across Brazil, Japan and the US. He was a Business Intelligence Engineer at Amazon in Tokyo and Head of Data & Tech at Cedar Brands, where he built a GCP data lakehouse architecture from scratch and led initiatives that lifted the group's brand conversion rates by more than 50%. Today he is Head of Data at Robbin.
